function checkField(data,fieldPath,expectedType){const parts=fieldPath.split('.');let val=data;for(const p of parts){if(val&&typeof val==='object'&&p in val){val=val[p];}else{return{present:false,typeMatch:false,actualType:'undefined',value:undefined};}}const actualType=Array.isArray(val)?'array':typeof val;const typeMatch=expectedType?actualType===expectedType||(expectedType==='number'&&actualType==='string'&&!isNaN(val)):true;return{present:true,typeMatch,actualType,value:val};}const input=$('Validate & Normalize').first().json;const schema=input.expectedSchema;const fields=schema.fields||schema.properties||{};const fieldEntries=Array.isArray(fields)?fields.map(f=>[f.name||f.field,f]):Object.entries(fields);const results=input.samplePayloads.map(payload=>{const fieldChecks=fieldEntries.map(([fieldName,fieldSpec])=>{const expectedType=typeof fieldSpec==='string'?fieldSpec:(fieldSpec.type||null);const required=typeof fieldSpec==='object'?fieldSpec.required!==false:true;const check=checkField(payload.data,fieldName,expectedType);return{field:fieldName,required,expectedType,...check};});const missingRequired=fieldChecks.filter(f=>f.required&&!f.present);const typeMismatches=fieldChecks.filter(f=>f.present&&!f.typeMatch);const valid=missingRequired.length===0&&typeMismatches.length===0;return{payloadId:payload.id,source:payload.source,valid,fieldChecks,missingRequired:missingRequired.map(f=>f.field),typeMismatches:typeMismatches.map(f=>({field:f.field,expected:f.expectedType,actual:f.actualType})),rawDataSample:JSON.stringify(payload.data).slice(0,400)};});const validCount=results.filter(r=>r.valid).length;return[{json:{schemaName:input.schemaName,payloadCount:input.payloadCount,validCount,invalidCount:results.length-validCount,results,replyEmail:input.replyEmail}}];

values.content: You analyze webhook payload validation results. You identify patterns in validation failures, distinguish between schema drift (upstream changed their payload format), integration bugs, and edge cases. You give specific guidance on how to handle each issue — whether to fix the schema, contact the sender, or add defensive handling. Always respond in valid JSON only.
